about: The props bundles, one row each, in the order the mod reads them (README, 'The bundles'). A prop is in exactly one, and its id is unique across all. The first is closed: it keeps the props it has and takes no new one. A new prop goes in the last open set. build.ps1, the scripts (sets.py), PropBundleBuilder, the mod's PropLibrary and StandardCheck (RLO-PERF-016) all read this table.

sets.name: first
sets.removed_why: Taken out on 26 Oct 2026: no code, design data, clip, branch or worktree named them, whole or built from parts. A feature that wants one models it anew in the open set; StandardCheck fails on code that names one.

sets.name: second
sets.source: models/<id>/: a Blender export each (README, 'Adding a prop from Blender')
